events.title: Play the first chapter for free!
events.summary: Nulphia now has a demo available on Steam. It includes the entire first chapter of the full game!It's available in English and Russian languages. The game fully supports game controllers, and runs great on Steam Deck as well (that's my favorite way to play it).If you like what you see, please add the full game to your wishlist!This is only the beginningIt took a lot of time and experiments to get to this point. events.title: Nulphia demo gameplay trailer
events.summary: For the past few months I've been hard at work making the first chapter for Nulphia. In a few days, I'm releasing the entire chapter as a free demo on Steam!Here's a new gameplay trailer:The demo will be available in English and Russian languages. There's full controller support, and the game runs great on Steam Deck.Follow the demo Steam page, and wishlist the full game to receive a notification when it's out.Thank you for all the support.

events.title: Towns, people, and dialogues in Nulphia
events.summary: The townWelcome to Qual Harbor - a small port town on the island of Nulphia, and the first settlement in the game.There were several iterations of the town's layout and art style. I aimed to have a location that makes sense, looks nice, and is fun to explore.There are multiple enterable buildings, as well as hidden treasures tucked away for those who like to snoop around.The peopleThe game has many NPCs for the player to interact with.
